title: Freeze All Enemies Alive state byte reported in RAM Watch
procedure: Operator toggled Freeze All Enemies Alive and watched 0x02C90C in RAM Watch domain RDRAM as decimal unsigned; independently tried same numeric offset via Lua System Bus.

observations.observation: mismatch with RAM Watch when OFF

observations.behavior: Enemy freezes in place on activation and resumes movement from that position on deactivation

hypotheses: System Bus physical-offset read does not necessarily map to RAM Watch RDRAM byte
